hero.h1: Track symptoms and vitals in seconds
hero.lede: Rianell's guided log makes it easy to record how you feel every day - then shows you the patterns behind it. Built for people managing long-term and chronic conditions who want a clear, private record over time.

cards.p: Rate pain and fatigue, mark symptom severity, and pinpoint pain regions on a body map.
Weight, heart rate, blood pressure and blood glucose, with clean charts over time.
Sleep, steps, hydration, exercise and food (including barcode scanning) in one place.
Keep medications and appointments alongside your logs so nothing gets lost.
Optional menstrual-cycle tracking that ties into how you feel day to day.
Add free-text notes to any entry to capture context a number can't.

sections.h2: From daily logs to real insight
paragraphs: Individual entries are useful, but the value comes from trends. Rianell turns your history into charts you can actually read, highlights what changed, and helps you prepare a concise summary to bring to appointments.
list: Spot which days, activities or treatments line up with better or worse symptoms.
Export a clean report to share with your GP, specialist or care team.
Keep everything in one private place instead of scattered notes and apps.

hero.lede: Living with a chronic condition affects how you feel, not just how you function. Rianell lets you track mood and, when you want, complete PHQ-9 and GAD-7 style check-ins - privately, on your own device.
hero.note: Rianell is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis or treatment. If you are in crisis or may be at risk of harming yourself, contact your local emergency services or a crisis line immediately.

cards.p: Capture how you feel in a tap, and see mood trends alongside your symptoms and sleep.
Start with a short check that can expand into full PHQ-9 or GAD-7 style questions only if relevant.
Screening responses are processed on-device and never saved to logs, local storage, or the cloud.

items.summary: What are the PHQ-9 and GAD-7?
items.body: They are widely used self-report questionnaires about how often you have experienced certain feelings over the past two weeks. Rianell offers them as optional, private check-ins to help you notice changes over time. They are screening tools, not a diagnosis.

items.summary: Does Rianell store or upload my answers?
items.body: No. Individual screening answers are processed on your device and are never written to logs, local databases, or the cloud.
No. A check-in can help you reflect and start a conversation with a qualified professional. If you may be at risk, contact a local health service or emergency line right away.
No. Mood tracking and check-ins are free and work without an account. You can optionally create one later for encrypted sync.

faqSchema.q: What are the PHQ-9 and GAD-7?
faqSchema.a: The PHQ-9 and GAD-7 are widely used self-report questionnaires that ask how often you have experienced certain feelings over the past two weeks. Rianell offers them as optional, private check-ins to help you notice changes over time. They are screening tools, not a diagnosis.

faqSchema.q: Does Rianell store or upload my answers?
faqSchema.a: No. Your individual screening answers are processed on your device and are never written to logs, local databases, or the cloud. Only you see them, in the moment you complete a check-in.

No. Rianell is not a medical device and does not diagnose. A check-in can help you reflect and start a conversation with a qualified professional. If you may be at risk, contact a local health service or emergency line right away.

faqSchema.q: Do I need an account to use mood tracking?
faqSchema.a: No. Mood tracking and check-ins are free and work without an account. You can optionally create an account later for encrypted sync across your devices.

ai-insights.description: Rianell runs AI on your device to generate weekly reviews, explain your charts, and prepare clinician briefs - without sending your health data to a server. Free and private.

hero.h1: AI insights that never send your data away
hero.lede: Rianell can run a language model directly on your device to summarise your week, explain what a chart is showing, and draft a brief you can hand to your clinician - all without uploading your health data anywhere.

cards.p: A plain-language summary of how your symptoms, mood and vitals moved over the last week.
Ask what a trend means and get a clear explanation grounded in your own data.
Generate a concise, structured summary to make the most of a short appointment.
Ask questions about your log in natural language, with the model running locally.

paragraphs: Most health apps send your data to a server for AI features. Rianell takes the opposite approach: the model runs in your browser or device, so the analysis happens where your data already lives. Nothing about your health is transmitted to run these features.
list: Runs on-device using efficient models, with graceful fallback on lower-powered hardware.
Works alongside encrypted, optional cloud sync - you choose what leaves your device.
Insight is guidance, not medical advice.
sections.note: AI output is informational only and can be imperfect. Always confirm important decisions with a qualified healthcare professional.

community.description: Opt in to Rianell's anonymised community to see how others with your chronic condition are doing, and contribute privacy-preserving data that helps people like you. Always opt-in, always anonymised.
community.ogDescription: See how others with your condition are doing and contribute privacy-preserving data that helps people like you. Always opt-in.
community.twDescription: See how others with your condition are doing and contribute privacy-preserving data. Always opt-in.
community.jsonldDescription: An opt-in, anonymised, privacy-preserving community that lets people with the same condition learn from each other.

hero.h1: Help others with your condition - and learn from them
hero.lede: Chronic illness can feel isolating. Rianell's opt-in community turns individual logs into anonymised, privacy-preserving insight, so you can see how people with the same condition are doing and contribute to knowledge that helps the next person.

cards.p: Shared insights use privacy-preserving aggregation, so no individual can be identified from the results.
Nothing is shared unless you explicitly turn on data sharing. You can turn it off again at any time.
Compare trends with others who share your condition and discover what tends to help.

paragraphs: When you choose to contribute, your anonymised patterns join a shared pool that reveals what people with your condition experience over time. It is a way to give back - to help researchers, clinicians and fellow patients understand conditions that are often under-studied.
list: Contribute anonymised data to help improve understanding of your condition.
Benefit from collective insight without exposing anyone's private records.
Stay in control: sharing is opt-in and reversible.
sections.note: Community insights are informational and not a substitute for professional medical advice.

hero.h1: Understand and track your chronic condition
hero.lede: Every condition has its own signals worth watching. These guides help you decide what to log, how often, and how to turn months of data into a clear story your clinicians can act on.

cards.p: Log daily pain, fatigue and flare triggers to reveal patterns behind good and bad days.
Follow weight, blood pressure, heart rate and glucose trends over weeks and months.
Pair mood check-ins with sleep and activity to understand what moves your baseline.
Capture symptoms, medications and lifestyle to correlate with flares and remission.

paragraphs: Consistent logging is only half the story. The goal is to walk into an appointment with a clear, honest picture of your recent weeks - not a vague memory. Rianell helps you:
list: Choose a small, sustainable set of things to track for your condition.
Watch trends instead of single readings, so noise doesn't mislead you.
Export a concise report and, optionally, an AI-drafted brief for your clinician.
sections.note: These guides are general information, not medical advice. Your care team knows your situation best - use your logs to inform that conversation.

about.intro: Rianell is a free, open-source personal health application designed to help people living with chronic conditions track symptoms, monitor key health metrics, and prepare meaningful insights to share with their healthcare team.

list: Daily health log - symptoms, pain scores, fatigue, mood, mobility, and more
Vitals tracking - weight, heart rate, blood pressure
AI-assisted trend analysis and condition insights
Export reports to share with clinicians
Optional cloud sync across devices (end-to-end encrypted)
Connect fitness and health devices via Strava, Withings, and Google Sheets

paragraphs: Users can optionally connect a Google Sheets spreadsheet to import existing health data or export their log for backup and analysis. The app accesses only the single spreadsheet the user explicitly provides. No other files or data are accessed.
All cloud data is stored encrypted. OAuth tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Row-Level Security ensures each user can only access their own data. The app never sells or shares your data.
Rianell is fully open source. The source code is available on GitHub.
